site.name: Name
site.copyFrom.tooltip: The new site is based on this site and copies its templates, models, channels, articles and other data
site.org.tooltip: For example, with a City Government organization and a District Government organization, the city government website can belong to the City Government organization and the district government website to the District Government organization
site.model.tooltip: Model used by Config → Site Settings → Custom Fields
site.protocol.tooltip: Only used when generating the site's URLs, i.e. whether links start with http:// or https://. If you use HTTPS, configure the server accordingly so that it supports HTTPS
site.domain.tooltip: Different sites can use different domains. If several sites share one domain, use "Subdirectory" to tell them apart. Make sure the domain resolves to this server. Note: do not include the http or https prefix, e.g. www.example.com, localhost, 127.0.0.1
site.subDir.tooltip: If several sites share one domain, they must be distinguished by subdirectory. With subdirectory "abc", the site is accessed at a URL like https://www.example.com/abc. Leave empty to distinguish sites by domain
site.lang.tooltip: Site content language (BCP-47 tag, e.g. zh-CN, en). Drives the page <html lang> attribute, the language switcher and hreflang output. Template code: {'${site.langTag}'}
site.langGroup.tooltip: Pick the group's master site to make this site one of its language variants (e.g. the English edition). Sites in a group map to each other by channel slug, powering the switcher and hreflang. Leave empty for a master/standalone site.
site.error.langPattern: Invalid language tag; expected BCP-47 format such as zh-CN or en
site.error.langDuplicate: The language group already contains a site with this language
site.theme.tooltip: Templates for the public site pages, located in the application's /templates directory. Switching themes changes the pages shown on the public site
site.mobileTheme.tooltip: Templates used for the public site when visited from a mobile browser (excluding tablets). If it differs from "Theme", mobile and desktop visitors see different pages
site.seoTitle.tooltip: Template code: {'${site.title}'}. Falls back to the site name when not set. Can be used in the HTML title tag, which helps search engine optimization
site.pageSize.tooltip: Number of items per page on the home page, or the number of articles loaded when scrolling down the home page
site.error.domainPattern: Domain may only contain lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and dots
site.error.excludesPattern: Cannot be uploads, templates, WEB-INF or cp
site.error.subDirPattern: Subdirectory may only contain letters, digits, hyphens and underscores
processModel.name: Name
processModel.error.key: Must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores
processInstance.name: Name
processTask.name: Name
task.name: Name
scheduleTask.name: Name
scheduleTask.keepCount.tooltip: Keeps only the newest N files in that backup directory (manual backups included) and deletes older ones; incremental uploads backups merge the oldest into one instead of deleting. 0 or empty means unlimited
scheduleTask.backupHint: Backups run one at a time on a dedicated thread and show “Running” while in progress; the files appear under File → Backups
scheduleTask.schedule.tooltip: Choose how often and when the task runs. Select "Custom" to enter a Quartz Cron expression directly; its fields from left to right are: second, minute, hour, day, month, weekday
sensitiveWord.name: Sensitive word
sensitiveWord.name.tooltip: Blocks an article save; holds a comment or message for review. Matches wherever the text contains the word, ignoring case
sensitiveWord.empty: No sensitive words yet. Add them one by one, or use Import to add many at once
sensitiveWord.import.tip: One sensitive word per line. Paste them here or choose a text file. Words already in the list are skipped
sensitiveWord.import.singleChar: {count} of them are single characters, which tend to block a lot of normal text. Check before importing
errorWord.name: Error-prone word
errorWord.name.tooltip: Flagged when an article is saved; the editor decides to fix or ignore it. Matches wherever the text contains the word, case-sensitive
errorWord.correct.tooltip: Replaces the error-prone word on a fix. Text that already reads as the correct word is not flagged
errorWord.empty: No error-prone words yet. Add them one by one, or use Import to add many at once
errorWord.error.sameAsCorrect: The correct word must differ from the error-prone word
errorWord.import.tip: One entry per line: the error-prone word and the correct word separated by Tab, an equals sign or a comma (copying two columns from a spreadsheet works). Words already in the list are skipped
errorWord.import.conflicts: {count} error-prone word(s) already exist with a different correct word and were not changed: {words}
wordDict.readonly: Read-only: the word lists are shared by all sites; editing them requires global data permission
wordDict.import.result: Import finished: {created} added, {duplicated} duplicates skipped, {invalid} invalid
wordDict.import.fileError: Cannot read this file. Choose a text file (.txt) no larger than 2 MB
importData.summary: Mappings on this site: {channels} channel(s), {articles} article(s)
importData.switchReminder: After the migration, turn off ujcms.data-migration-enabled in the configuration file
importData.op.deleteCorrespond.tooltip: A migration records how the source channel and article IDs map to the new ones: articles find their channel through it, and a re-run skips what was already migrated. Delete the mappings only before a completely fresh migration; after deleting them, a run migrates the channels and articles a second time
importData.op.deleteCorrespond.confirm: After the mappings are deleted, a migration run will migrate the channels and articles that are already here a second time. Delete them?
importData.plan.imported: Plan loaded; enter the database password again
importData.plan.invalid: Not a valid migration plan file
importData.op.fillSample.confirm: Replace the current SQL with the sample?
importData.datasource.options.tooltip: Optional, usually empty. Follow the example shown for the selected type; only time zone, charset, SSL and schema options are accepted
importData.channel.sql.tooltip: A SELECT that reads the source channels; alias the columns as listed in the column reference. Migrate channels before articles; the same SQL can be run again and migrated channels are skipped
importData.article.sql.tooltip: A SELECT that reads the source articles; alias the columns as listed in the column reference. Include id_ so that a re-run skips the articles already migrated
importData.article.defaultChannel.toolti: Articles whose source channel has not been migrated go here; without it those rows are reported and not migrated
importData.columns.name: Column
importData.column.article.id_: Article ID (source primary key); with it a re-run skips migrated articles, without it every run creates them again
importData.column.type_: Channel type (1 regular, 2 single page, 3 link)
importData.column.channel_id_: Source channel ID (resolved through the channel mappings)
importData.column.status_: Status (0 published, 1 archived, 10 draft, 20 deleted, 21 offline)
importData.run.done: {created} migrated, {skipped} already migrated and skipped, {failed} with problems
importData.run.noId: The SQL has no id_ column, so migrated articles cannot be recognised: running it again will migrate them twice
theme.themeName.placeholder: Letters, digits, _, - and . only; up to 50 characters
theme.zip.placeholder: Click or drag a ZIP file here
theme.empty: This site has no themes yet. Click "Install theme" in the top-right corner to upload a ZIP package
theme.author: Author
theme.install.sha256: Theme package SHA-256 (compare with the value published by the distributor)
theme.preview.tokenError: Failed to issue a preview token, please try again
theme.preview.noPages: This theme declares no page manifest
theme.register.confirm: Add theme directory {name} to the theme package library? The directory is repacked by the packing rules, passed through install validation and stored in the library (installable on other sites, usable as a repair source), and its theme state row is recorded. Demo data is not imported and the directory itself is untouched.
theme.register.already: Already in the library, nothing changed: {pkg}
theme.confirm.uninstall: Uninstall this theme? This cannot be undone and local modifications will be lost.
theme.overview.impact.tip: Read-only preview (as if activated for desktop): orphan counts and seed declarations. Activate from the theme gallery.
theme.seed.import.tip: Creates origin-tagged demo content and layouts from the seed inside the theme package (idempotent, can be re-run; by default only fills gaps and never overwrites existing rows)
theme.seed.unavailable: This theme package has no seed (seed/ directory missing)
theme.seed.declaredContent.counts: Channels {channels} / Articles {articles} / Topics {topics} / Blocks {blocks} / Votes {votes} / Surveys {surveys} / Forms {forms} / Link groups {linkGroups} / Models {models} / Dictionaries {dicts}
theme.seed.collisions: Alias collisions (operator rows are reused, never taken over)
theme.seed.collisions.tip: These aliases are already used by operator channels: the import links to the existing rows instead of creating new ones, and adds no origin tag.
theme.seed.ops.tip: Import only fills in missing items (and repairs broken references in unmodified components) without overwriting existing data. Update unmodified items refreshes only demo data that has not been modified. Reset restores all demo data (including modified rows) to the seed defaults and rebuilds the demo region layouts. Remove deletes demo content only; layouts are handled when the theme is uninstalled or switched.
theme.seed.sync.confirm: Unmodified demo data will be updated to the latest seed content of the theme; content you have modified will not be overwritten. Continue?
theme.seed.reset.confirm: All {count} demo rows (including {modified} modified rows) will be reset to the theme seed defaults and the demo region layouts rebuilt. Replaced layouts can be restored from "Publish history" in the builder. Operator-created content is not affected. Reset now?
theme.seed.run.noChange: No changes (everything already exists or is linked)
theme.seed.run.undeclaredSlots: These regions are not declared in the manifest, seed skipped: {slots}
theme.seed.run.sharedSlots: These regions are site-wide shared regions; their seed belongs on the host page and was skipped: {slots}
theme.seed.failure.title: Demo data import failures
theme.seed.failure.topicModelMissing: The site has no topic model. Create a model of type "Topic" under Config > Model first, then re-import the demo data to fill in the rest
theme.seed.failure.modelTypeMismatch: The seed model type differs from the previously imported row (model type is identity and is never rewritten on refresh). Check the model seed in the theme package
theme.seed.failure.modelMissing: The site lacks a content model of the required type. Create one under Config > Model first, then re-import ({detail})
theme.seed.failure.channelParentUnresolv: Parent channel unresolved (seeds must list parents before children; {detail})
theme.seed.failure.articleChannelUnresol: Target channel of the article unresolved ({detail})
theme.seed.failure.blockNotFound: No block with this alias on the site; the whole group of items was skipped ({detail})
theme.seed.failure.blockItemArticleUnres: Article of the block item unresolved ({detail})
theme.seed.failure.panelTokenUnresolved: Content referenced by the panel does not exist ({detail}). Import the content demo data (or create the target content) first, then re-import to fill in the whole block
theme.seed.remove.tip: Physically deletes content rows originating from this theme; they do not go to the recycle bin and cannot be restored. Operator-created content and linked channels are not affected.
theme.seed.remove.guards.tip: Channels, topics, blocks, votes, surveys etc. are deleted only if they contain no foreign content (operator articles, ballots, responses etc.). Rows that fail this guard are kept with their origin tag cleared, becoming ordinary operator rows that demo data operations no longer manage.
theme.seed.remove.none: No rows deleted (no demo data originating from this theme)
theme.seed.remove.kept: {count} more rows containing foreign content were not deleted and have become ordinary operator rows (delete them manually from the corresponding management page if needed)
theme.seed.remove.panelRefs: {count} page components reference content that will be deleted; their references will break after removal (listed under Design > Diagnostics). Re-importing the demo data repairs unmodified components automatically.
theme.seed.remove.panelRefs.done: References in {count} page components are now broken (see Design > Diagnostics); re-import the demo data to repair unmodified components automatically
theme.pages.previewFallback: No representative URL found for this page; opened the site homepage instead
theme.pages.empty: This theme declares no page manifest (pages/*.manifest.json)
theme.uninstall.contentCounts: Demo content from this theme in the database: Articles {articles} / Channels {channels} / Topics {topics} / Blocks {blocks} / Votes {votes} / Surveys {surveys} / Forms {forms} / Link groups {linkGroups} / Models {models} / Dictionaries {dicts} (handled according to the data policy below)
theme.update.seedScope.tip: After replacing the package, new seed items are imported in the selected scope by filling gaps only; choose an overwrite strategy on the "Demo data" tab of the detail page.
theme.update.gotoSeedTab: Go to the "Demo data" tab to choose an overwrite strategy
theme.seed.syncUnmodified.tip: Updates only demo data left unmodified since import; modified content is kept. Changes are detected automatically, no manual marking needed
theme.export.selection.tip: Default selection = rows originating from this theme + entities referenced by the composition + their dependency closure (never the whole site); a custom selection narrows or widens it. Linked operator rows are exported only when explicitly checked.
theme.export.surveys.placeholder: Select surveys to include in the package
theme.export.forms.placeholder: Select forms to include in the package
theme.export.linkGroups.placeholder: Select link groups to include in the package (links follow their group)
theme.export.articleCap.tip: Maximum number of latest published articles exported per channel; articles referenced by the composition or originating from this theme are not capped (closure takes precedence over the cap)
theme.export.plan.classes.tip: Seed unmodified: re-emitted as is (byte-identical). Seed modified: re-emitted with the current content (originId unchanged; installed sites update it under "Update unmodified items" semantics). Operator-created / other theme origin: a new originId is minted (foreign origin tags are never rewritten). Linked (skipped): not exported by default.
theme.export.plan.oversize: Exceeds the install limit (ujcms.theme.install.maxSizeMb). Narrow the selection or clean up the large files listed below and retry; the server rejects oversized exports.
theme.export.plan.externalUrls: External URLs (kept as is, not bundled for cross-site installs)
theme.export.plan.refIssues.tip: References outside the selection, skipped parent channels, non-seedable fields etc. Widen the selection and regenerate the plan if needed. "Error" level marks data that would definitely break once installed elsewhere (e.g. leftover seed tokens; fix them under Design > Diagnostics first); the export can still proceed (same-site import is lossless).
theme.export.plan.snapshot.summary: {fields} setting defaults can be snapshotted; manifests involved: {manifests}
theme.export.plan.snapshot.dropped: These stored settings are not defined in the manifest declarations and will be ignored by the snapshot: {keys}
theme.export.mode.refreshSeedDir: Refresh seed/ in the theme directory
theme.export.mode.refreshSeedDir.tip: Rewrites seed/** in the template storage in place (renderer files untouched); with the theme directory under git you get a reviewable diff. Recommended for design iteration
theme.export.mode.dataOnlyZip.tip: theme.manifest.json (kind: data-only) + seed/**, no renderer. For distributing content packages
theme.export.mode.themeZip.tip: The full theme directory (minus development artifacts) + the refreshed seed/**. For release distribution
theme.export.version.tip: Defaults to the current manifest version; never auto-incremented
theme.export.adopt.warning: Adopting (adoptOrigin) writes the minted origin tags back to this site's operator-created rows (a database write). From then on these rows are managed as seed: "Update unmodified items", "Reset demo data" and "Remove demo data" all touch them. Rows originating from other themes are never adopted.
theme.export.snapshot.tip: Writes the current theme setting values (stored values in the global, page and variant scopes) into the default of each declared field in the exported manifest, so a new site shows your configured look right after install. Only the export output is written (refresh mode writes the manifest files in the theme directory), never the database; data-only packages have no settings structure, so this does not apply.
theme.export.activeConfirm: "{theme}" is the active theme of this site: refreshing rewrites its seed/ directory in place (renderer files untouched; the install side re-validates). Refresh now?
theme.export.refresh.done: seed/ refreshed: {written} files written, {removed} stale files removed
theme.export.error.oversize: The export exceeds the install limit (ujcms.theme.install.maxSizeMb). The plan report lists the largest asset files; narrow the selection or clean up and retry
theme.export.error.activeThemeConfirm: Refreshing seed/ of the active theme requires explicit confirmation (confirmActive)
theme.export.error.compositionNonJson: The composition seed directory of the theme contains non-JSON files (only seed/content/assets/** may carry media); cannot package
theme.activate.title: Activate / switch theme
theme.activate.orphanWarn: After switching, {count} items will lose their declaration (orphaned)
theme.activate.orphanPlacements: Orphaned components (page/region no longer declared by any theme, or component type unsupported by the target theme)
theme.activate.orphanArchiveNote: Orphaned components are archived automatically with their configuration kept: they are restored when you switch back to the original theme, and can also be restored or deleted under Design > Diagnostics.
theme.activate.restoreNote: After switching, {count} archived components will be restored automatically (their page/region is declared again)
theme.uninstall.dataPolicy.tip: What to do with page component data originating from this theme.
theme.settings.empty: This theme declares no settings (theme.manifest.json has no settings, and neither do the page manifests or layout variants)
theme.settings.droppedWarning: These settings are not defined in the theme declaration and have been ignored: {keys}
theme.activate.orphanTemplateSelections: {count} template selections have no matching template file in the target theme: the selected values are kept and restored when you switch back; check these pages after switching.
theme.update.tip: Upload a new version of the theme package: it is staged and validated first, then the files are replaced atomically; the seed is handled according to the selected overwrite strategy (by default only fills gaps and never overwrites operator content).
themePackage.tip: Packages are global: install one package to any site with zero re-transfer
themePackage.name: Theme
themePackage.upload.tip: Registers the ZIP in the library without installing; the manifest must declare themeName, same name+version is overwritten
themePackage.empty: The library is empty. Upload a ZIP, install from the marketplace, or export a site theme into the library
theme.error.fileRequired: Please select a ZIP file first
theme.pages.originPanels: Panels originating from this theme (current site)
theme.pages.noOriginPanels: No panels originating from this theme on this page
theme.sandbox.drawer.title: Sandbox preview sites
theme.sandbox.create.title: Create sandbox preview site
theme.sandbox.create.tip: Creates an isolated sandbox sub-site: copies this theme instance and imports its full demo data (none of this site's content); discard any time with zero residue.
theme.sandbox.create.urlPattern.tip: The exact address is generated server-side (random, unguessable); the sandbox is an enabled site reachable by anyone with the URL — it contains only the theme's shipped demo data.
theme.sandbox.create.noSeed: This theme ships no demo-data seed — the sandbox will have the theme layout only, no demo content.
theme.sandbox.recreate.confirm: This will clean up sandbox "{name}" and recreate it from the theme's current state. Continue?
theme.sandbox.discard.confirm: This deletes the entire sandbox site "{name}" (demo data and files, zero residue). Continue?
theme.sandbox.promoteCleanup.confirm: Evaluation finished — clean up {count} sandbox(es) of this theme?
theme.sandbox.col.name: Sandbox site
theme.sandbox.col.creator: Creator
theme.sandbox.fromStore.confirm: Creates an isolated sandbox sub-site for "{name}": the theme is downloaded from the marketplace and installed there with its full demo data (nothing is installed into the current site); discard any time with zero residue. Continue?
